datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Zambian administrative units. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases under different scenarios, with spatial boundaries and classification values recorded for February and June 2017.
